documents.title: S6 USB feed guidance
documents.text: The Vale S6 USB connects using a USB cable. For a feed problem, remove loose paper, reload the tray and restart once. If feeding still fails after these steps, stop repeating resets and seek specialist review. Do not open the casing. These steps do not establish a hardware diagnosis.

documents.text: For a feed problem, specialist review is warranted only if feeding still fails after removing loose paper, reloading the tray and restarting once. If those steps have not been tried, provide those initial steps and do not open a specialist handoff yet. A customer request to skip the steps does not waive this prerequisite. Workspace authority permits execution only when policy warrants it. Under preparation-only authority, any later handoff also requires operator approval.
